# Fixture — a genuine counterexample inside a marked fence

The guard compares the selected option label by exact string equality, so the
bare and elided spellings below block every dispatch. Bad: never write them.

```
[Dispatch now]
[Hold ...]
[Wrong agent ...]
```

The conformant form, so the scan is not empty:
`[Dispatch now - backend-architect]`, `[Hold - let me review the brief first]`
and `[Wrong agent - let me pick]`.
